verdict.rationale: Semgrep is a static-analysis/security scanning product, not an agentic orchestrator that consumes external tools; the evidence instead shows Semgrep itself ships an official MCP server (semgrep-probe-3) exposing its own scanning capabilities to other agents — the reverse role from the story. There is no indication Semgrep acts as an MCP client that plugs in third-party MCP servers to extend its own tool use, so this client-side axis does not apply to this product category.
